Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Activate Temur Charger by tapping it, adding {G}.

Temur Charger triggers, giving target creature trample until end of turn.

1619-2292-4605-5542-6136.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Avenging Hunter from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Avenging Hunter enters, it triggers once and Preston triggers twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Avenging Hunter.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Avenging Hunter that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Avenging Hunter token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Avenging Hunter token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Avenging Hunter that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the Avenging Hunter trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-2292-4605-5542-6136.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

Repeat from step 2.
Activate Nissa's first loyalty ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, animating a Forest you control.
Cast Springheart Nantuko for its bestow cost by paying {1}{G}, attaching it to the animated Forest.
Activate the animated Forest by tapping it, adding {G}.
Nissa triggers, adding {G}.
Play a land.
When the land enters the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of the Forest it is attached to.
When the Forest token enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko triggers.
Holding priority, activate the Forest token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Nissa triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of the Forest it is attached to.
Repeat from step 6.
